description: This file defines an enum 'GatewayStatusBuilder' with a static method 'build' that determines the gateway status (connected, connecting, error, disconnected) based on an 'appModel' object. The method analyzes the 'gatewayServerName' and 'gatewayStatusText' properties of 'appModel' to produce a 'StatusPill.GatewayState'.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns a 'StatusPill.GatewayState' based on the 'appModel's' properties, indicating the current gateway connection status.
